reason: E1 states ESD produces coatings with low oxygen concentration and that HEA coatings can enhance high-temperature corrosion resistance, supporting the barrier premise. However, no cited evidence demonstrates that an HfNbTaTiZr coating reduces oxidation of the same alloy, that it acts as an oxygen diffusion barrier, or that it improves high-temperature mechanical performance; these are unsupported extrapolations.
premises: Electrospark deposition (ESD) can produce HfNbTaTiZr coatings with low oxygen concentration due to argon shielding
ESD does not induce thermal stress to coated parts
HEA coatings can enhance resistance to high-temperature wear or corrosion
The HfNbTaTiZr coating will act as an oxygen diffusion barrier
The coating will improve high-temperature mechanical performance
